native_session.mission_understood: OPHANIM learns to derive and evaluate plans through hypothetical exercises; this is not project execution.
discipline: One active exercise and one targeted diagnostic question.
Assess against observed criteria; preserve unknowns and coached/unassisted distinctions.
Create next itinerary at every assessment handoff/session end.
Coordinator writes records; coach is advisory.
Final transfer assessor must be separate.

native_session.assessment_limit: Readiness and charter comprehension only; no learning result or coaching-quality qualification.
